result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, **I'd recommend Freshdesk as the best all-round help desk software in 2026.** It offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation, reporting and room to grow without the complexity of enterprise platforms.

However, the best choice depends on how your team handles customer enquiries.

## My top 6 help desk software recommendations

![Freshworks Analytics: Unlock Business Insights with No-Code](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2zAYGZIG7STCmySRXK3EqpVOdqvoICkef7TXhVl-781FLa6un-JzufxVH6TqKjui9eY33DE6UeiqJkWFjxjRyX8fabSdkeaDer4crvDbovi9S4y1-jWC-YjfWxUwSK6muTOem3STwis5zZLDZ9RNlt8px1NBGzksRIXBGUWl8LOI-Mn22oilAEI50dFkcOGC?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

From US\$19/agent/month, annual billing

- Excellent ticket management and automation.
- Email, chat and multichannel support.
- Good reporting and team performance tracking.
- Scales well as your team grows.

Best for: Small teams wanting a proper help desk without overspending.

[Official website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

Free plan available; paid from US\$25/user/month annually

- Very easy to learn and use.
- Excellent shared email inbox.
- Knowledge base and customer self-service.
- Strong collaboration features.

Best for: Teams of 2–10 people primarily handling email enquiries.

[Official website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---
